findings.title: Do not describe `bulkEncrypt` as untyped. Line 234 groups `bulkEncrypt` with `bulkDecrypt` as untyped, but `bulkEncrypt` remains column-typed through `BulkEncry
findings.label: incorrect
findings.note: At head, README line 234 explicitly says bulkEncrypt is typed like encrypt via { table, column } and only bulkDecrypt resolves to the untyped union; the PR removed the 'untyped passthroughs' wording the finding complains about.
